parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried request safe. Required on every POST and PUT (400 `idempotency-key-required`; `idempotency-key-invalid` when malformed). A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. What is replayed depends on the replay class of the problem type (ADR 0019). A success is replayed. A refusal that cannot change for that request (a malformed or invalid field, a 404 on an id this service minted, 422 `validation`) is replayed too, and so is 409 `carrier-suspended`, whose REJECTED visit was committed with it. A refusal the same request could pass later is NOT stored: the key stays free and the retry runs the command again. Those are the optimistic-lock conflict 409 `concurrent-modification`, a state the aggregate is not in yet (409 `visit-already-open`, 409 `trailer-on-hold`, 409 `location-occupied`), a fact that has not arrived yet (422 `unknown-location`, 422 `unknown-appointment`) and 404 `no-claimable-move`. A 5xx is never stored. After such a refusal the key is free, so the same key with a different body is a new request, not `idempotency-key-reused`.
